parsed.explanation: The division sits under a hostile parent regime whose visitor-facing exposures it cannot neutralise: the federal binary passport rule (X markers halted, markers forced to birth sex), the February 2025 visa cable instructing refusal and possible lifetime fraud findings where 'reasonable doubt' about sex exists, secondary-screening outing risk, and documented detentions/strandings of foreign trans travellers. That is a universal-exposure border/document layer every visitor passes through. But this state/province adds documented protective machinery actually operating: codified gender-identity non-discrimination (2023), an explicit hate-crime statute, panic-defence and conversion-therapy bans, birth-certificate and licence marker changes, and a low-risk band on the 2026 risk map, with no local facility ban, no local criminal offence, and no local enforcement incidents. Per rule 12 this places it materially above the parent average. Residual deductions: the unresolved federal litigation regime, the advisory 2025 athletics resolution signalling friction, unconfirmed X-marker licences, and undocumented custody/healthcare shortfalls. Result: elevated-to-reduced boundary, ~0.62.
